en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a tall, cylindrical stone observation tower standing on a hill in a rural landscape. The tower has small rectangular windows, a decorative cornice near the top, and a circular viewing platform with a railing and a central flagpole. At the base is a two‑storey stone structure with a main wooden door and a terrace surrounded by a metal railing. In front of the entrance are simple outdoor tables and benches. A sign over the entrance reads "Heimaths-Thurm." The background shows rolling fields and distant hills under an empty sky.
